cafe_complete: The café is fully restored. Thank you!
cafe_complete_extras: The café is restored! Collect extras in Restore.
choose_body: Tap an option to see it in the café. You can change it later.
counter_full: Counter full — send items straight to orders

daily_basis: A new puzzle every day at midnight on this device's clock. Everyone on the same app version gets the same puzzle for the same date.
daily_clock_note: Daily results are stored only on this device. Changing the device clock changes the puzzle; daily play awards no tokens.
extra_desc_cakestand: A tiered stand on the counter.
extra_desc_cat: Naps on a cushion by the counter.
finale_body: Tiny Street Café is open again. The neighbours are lining up for coffee. You can keep replaying levels for stars and change the décor any time.
finale_campaign_body: You've served every order on Tiny Street. The café is buzzing. Replay levels for stars, collect extras, and check the Journal for café tasks.
finale_restore_body: You've earned enough tokens for the final restoration.
help_auto_b: When an order needs something on the counter, it moves over by itself. Finished orders leave and the next customer steps up.
help_badges_b: The badge on each crate's front item shows where a tap sends it: a numbered order, the counter, a clock (fresh item has to wait), or a cross (nowhere to go). Press and hold to see the path; you can also drag the item.
help_bag_b: A paper bag hides its item until it reaches the front of the crate. The rules always know what's inside; you find out when you unwrap it.
help_counter_b: If no order needs the item, it waits on the counter. The counter has limited space.
help_fresh_b: Fresh items must go straight into an order. If no order needs one yet, it stays in its crate and blocks the items behind it.
help_goal_b: Fill every customer order using the products in the crates.
help_hint_b: One free hint per attempt, worked out from your current position. Hints never affect stars.
help_lock_b: A strapped crate opens after the number of orders on its tag has been served. You can't take anything from it before then.
help_lose_b: If no front item fits an order or the counter, the attempt is stuck. A full counter is fine as long as an item can go straight to an order.
help_priority_b: An item goes to the LEFTMOST order (lowest number) that still needs it. Press and hold a crate to preview its destination before you let go.
help_stars_b: ★ complete. ★★ keep peak counter use at the level's target. ★★★ also use at most 1 undo and no extra space.
help_tap_b: Only the front item of a crate can be picked. You can always see everything behind it.
help_tasks_b: The Journal has three café tasks a day and a collection of awards. Both pay tokens once each. Streaks are just for fun: they never change stars.
help_tokens_b: Each level gives 1 restoration token the first time you clear it. Spend tokens to restore the café step by step. No purchase is ever needed.
help_two_stage_b: Some customers order in two parts. The second part is shown under “then” and starts as soon as the first part is complete.
help_undo_b: Undo is free and unlimited and restores everything, including automatic deliveries. Restart is free too.
hint_stuck_restart: This position can't be finished. Restart to try a new route.
hint_stuck_undo: This position can't be finished. Undo %s move(s) — undo is free.
hint_timeout: No quick hint found. Try undoing a move.
hint_used_body: You've used this attempt's free hint. Hints never affect your stars.
hint_used_noads: You've used this attempt's free hint. Restarting gives you a fresh one. Hints never affect your stars.
hint_watch_ad: Watch a short ad for a hint
invalid_fresh: Fresh items can't wait on the counter. Serve an order that needs it first.
invalid_locked: This crate is strapped shut. It opens after %s more order(s).
invalid_no_space: No order needs this and the counter is full
lost_body: No crate's front item fits an order or the counter. Undo is free, or start again.
lost_body_fresh: A fresh item is blocking the way and no order needs it yet. Undo is free.
lost_body_locked: The items you need are in a strapped crate that hasn't opened yet. Undo is free.
privacy_ads_admob: Optional rewarded ads are provided by Google AdMob (test ads in this build). Ads are only shown when you choose to watch one. Consent is requested where required.
privacy_ads_none: This build contains no advertising SDK.
privacy_ads_sim: Development build: ads are simulated on-device; no ad network is contacted.
privacy_analytics_local: Gameplay events are counted locally for development only; this build sends no analytics.
privacy_contact_pending: Support contact: to be added before release.
privacy_local: Your progress is saved only on this device.
privacy_no_account: No account, login, contacts, location or chat.
privacy_permissions: Permissions: vibration only (ad builds also use internet access).
privacy_purchases_disabled: This build has no in-app purchases.
privacy_purchases_play: Purchases are processed by Google Play.
privacy_purchases_simulated: Development build: the store is simulated and never charges.
purchase_failed: Purchase failed. You haven't been charged.
purchase_pending: Payment pending. The theme unlocks when it completes.
purchase_purchased: Thank you! The theme is now in Restore.
purchase_revoked: A purchase was refunded and removed.
reset_body: This erases levels, stars, tokens and café restoration on this device. Settings and purchases are kept.
rush_body: %s puzzles back to back. The clock only counts up — no fail state, just your personal best.
save_recovered: Your save was restored from a backup copy.
save_reset: The save file was damaged and could not be recovered. Starting fresh.
share_copied: Result copied — paste it anywhere to share.
shop_note: All levels and the full café restoration are free. Purchases are cosmetic only.
shop_unavailable: The shop isn't available in this version.
sku_theme_evening_desc: Cosmetic only: adds an Evening wall colour, iron-and-gold seating and a lit sign to the café. It doesn't affect puzzles.
st_bag_1: Some suppliers wrap things in paper bags. You won't know what's inside until it's at the front!
st_basil_1: Good morning. Basil — I delivered the post on this street for forty years.
st_basil_2: I'll take tea, if you please. Only ever tea.
st_ch2_1: Word's getting around. Expect a morning rush — keep that counter tidy!
st_ch6_1: Look at you — running the whole counter like a head barista!
st_ch6_2: Everything at once now: fresh cups, paper bags, strapped crates. You've got this.
st_fresh_1: Careful, that's FRESH coffee! It goes straight in my order, or it goes cold. No parking it on the counter!
st_intro_1: Oh! You must be the new owner. I'm Mira, from the bakery next door. Welcome to Tiny Street!
st_intro_2: The café's been shut for years, but the deliveries still come. Let's sort them, serve the neighbours, and bring this place back to life.
st_lock_1: Delivery day! Some crates come strapped shut. The tag says how many orders until the driver unlocks them.
st_lock_2: So… plan ahead? Ugh. Fine. After coffee.
st_step_clean: Much better! You can actually see the street through that window now.
st_step_counter: I've polished the espresso machine. I'll lend a hand behind the counter when it's busy.
st_step_counter_2: Is it… is it working? It's working. I could cry.
st_step_floor: A proper floor. My knees thank you.
st_step_lights: Warm light. Just like the old days. The street looks friendlier already.
st_step_opening: Tiny Street Café — open again. I never thought I'd see the day.
st_step_opening_2: Everyone's here! Look at the queue!
st_step_opening_3: Best. Café. On the street. (It's the only one, but still.)
st_step_plants: Plants make everything better. I brought a cutting from the bakery.
st_step_seating: Dibs on the table by the window.
st_step_walls: Whoa, paint! It doesn't look haunted any more.
st_theo_1: Morning… is it morning? Coffee. Just coffee. Please.
st_theo_2: That's Theo, our sleepy student. He only ever orders coffee — you'll see his face a lot!
st_two_1: In my day we ordered properly: tea first, and THEN the cake. Two parts, if you please.
star_rules:
★ Complete the level
★★ Keep peak counter use at %s or less
★★★ Also use at most 1 undo and no extra space
Hints never affect stars.
step_desc_clean: Take the boards off the window, clear the boxes and sweep away the dust.
step_desc_counter: Polish the counter and fire up the espresso machine. Mira will help out.
step_desc_floor: Replace the broken boards. Oak, checker tiles or terracotta.
step_desc_lights: Warm light for cosy evenings: pendants, string lights or globes.
step_desc_opening: Hang the sign and open the doors to the street!
step_desc_plants: Greenery everywhere, plus a window box.
step_desc_seating: Somewhere for the regulars to sit.
step_desc_walls: Fresh paint and a wainscot. Pick a colour.
story_none: Story moments you've seen will appear here.
street_teaser: Next door, the old bakery's windows are still boarded up… Mira has plans. (A future update — nothing to unlock yet.)
tasks_clock_note: Tasks change at midnight on this device's clock. They're a relaxed personal goal, not a competition.
tasks_intro: Three small café tasks each day. Any puzzle counts: campaign, replays, Daily or Rush.
tasks_ready_n: %s café task(s) ready to claim in the Journal.
tips_reset: Tutorial tips will show again on the first levels.
tokens_how: %s more token(s) needed. Every star you earn is 1 token.
tut_bag_1: Paper bags hide what's inside until they reach the front. Tap to unwrap.
tut_bag_2: Unwrap early to plan ahead — or keep the counter clear and see what comes.
tut_counter_1: No order needs this yet. Tap it anyway — it waits on the counter.
tut_counter_2: Counter items jump into orders automatically when needed.
tut_counter_3: Watch the counter's space. Undo is always free.
tut_fresh_1: Steam means FRESH: hot items must go straight into an order. They can never wait on the counter.
tut_fresh_2: The clock badge means "wait". Serve the tea first so the coffee customer arrives.
tut_fresh_3: Now an order needs coffee: the fresh cups can go!
tut_lock_1: This crate is strapped shut. The tag shows how many orders must be served before it opens.
tut_lock_2: Serve orders to open it. Plan around what you can't reach yet.
tut_priority_1: Two orders! Items go to the LEFTMOST order that needs them. Press and hold a crate to preview.
tut_priority_2: Plan which order fills first to keep the counter tidy.
tut_tap_1: Tap the glowing crate. Its front item goes straight to the order.
tut_tap_2: Keep going! Fill the order to send the customer on their way.
tut_two_stage_1: Two-part order! When the first part is done, the second part (under "then") is next.
tut_two_stage_2: Items for the second part wait on the counter until that part is open.
win_no_new_tokens: No new stars, so no new tokens. Each star is worth 1 token, once.
win_star_tip: For more stars: keep the counter at %s or less, with at most 1 undo.
